placeholder_convention: Braced identifiers are documentation placeholders, not text sent literally to a model.
file_bytes: Prompt-constant text files have no added terminal newline. The Qwen full template intentionally ends with two newlines from the recorded suffix.

translation_messages.content_assembly: Join the ordered parts below with exactly two newline characters.

user_parts: T3 only: terminology block, if at least one source head matched
中文： followed immediately by source.strip()

terminology_block.option_handling: Keep each distinct associated glossary cell value as an unchanged string. Do not split or rewrite a cell value during prompt assembly. Group all options of one Chinese head on one line.

source_matching.order: Sort Chinese heads by descending character length, then lexicographic order.
source_matching.span_rule: Literal, non-overlapping source spans, with longer matches taking priority.
source_matching.occurrences: Scan all occurrences; include each selected Chinese head at most once per sentence.
source_matching.options: Retain all distinct Kazakh cell values associated with each selected head, in input order.
source_matching.normalization: No source spelling correction, stemming or synonym expansion is added by this matcher.

no_terms_behavior: Omit the terminology block entirely, without inserting an empty extra part. For new-source expansion, T3 is still generated using its own T3 instruction and decoding parameters.

qwen.display_probability: sigmoid(yes_logit - no_logit), not a calibrated translation-quality probability
